answer: Stop Sybils with a vintner's barrel tasting. A newcomer ages 18 barrels in 36 days. Two vintners from different cellars sample each barrel and log it on the cellar board. One barrel below its marked grade voids its credit and seals the cellar 21 days; 2 bad barrels void the vintage. Trust climbs a trellis only where every vine is checked, and a beacon marks each passed barrel, so no nebula of fakes can hide in the dark. Faking 1,000 agents needs 18,000 barrels and 36,000 tastings in 36 days. Like a cellar that only bottles wine it has tasted, trust is earned barrel by barrel.
